enrichment.research_summary: The EPIC (Emergent Phenomena from Interactions & Constraints) lab, led by Professor Edward Dongmyung Lee, focuses on the physics of collective decision-making. The research explores how collective decisions emerge from dynamical and structured interactions among complex components, such as in political, biological, or organizational systems. Key theoretical questions include how to represent sophisticated decision-makers, how computational and information costs constrain collective decision-making, and how the set of possible decisions evolves through innovation and obsolescence.

enrichment.research_summary: The Photoresponsive Materials Lab, led by Professor Junhua Yu, focuses on the development of luminescent noble metal nanodots. Their research explores the photophysical properties of these nanodots, which are similar to semiconductor quantum dots, and their applications in areas such as probes, phosphors, electroluminescent materials, and bio-labeling. Additionally, the lab is involved in educational research aimed at promoting nanoscience in school curricula.

enrichment.research_summary: The Systems Chemical Biology Lab, led by Prof. Hyun-Woo Rhee, focuses on developing and applying chemical biology tools to map localized protein information in living cells. Key research areas include proximity labeling (PL) methods (e.g., Spot-ID, SR-PL, GEN-Click) to uncover spatiotemporal subcellular distributions of biomolecules, the study of mitochondrial thermogenesis and its signaling, and the development of genetically encodable fluorescent reporters for intracellular visualization.

enrichment.research_summary: The Structural Biochemistry Laboratory, led by Professor Hyung Ho Lee, focuses on understanding the molecular mechanisms of membrane receptors and channels, which serve as gateways for cellular sensing and signaling. The lab utilizes structural biology techniques, primarily cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) and X-ray crystallography, to reveal the atomic-level structures of biomolecules. These structural insights are complemented by biochemical, biophysical, and cell biological studies to investigate protein-protein interactions, protein-membrane interplays, and signal transduction cascades. Additionally, the lab applies structure-based drug discovery (SBDD) methods to target proteins implicated in human diseases, including cancer.

posterCandidates.alt: 24년 겨울부터 25년까지 ldpl MLA/학부연구생들과 함께 설계한 동성로 통신골목 가로공간 및 삼각광장 조성 작업 중 삼각광장이 최근 완공되었습니다. 대구 도심의 교통광장적 성격이 강했던 공간을 보행자가 머무르고 도시의 풍경을 경험할 수 있는 공공공간으로 전환하고자 했습니다. 디자인 제안부터 설계, 심의와 실시설계에 이르기까지 여러 단계의 과정을 함께 고민하고 작업에 참여해주신 모든 분들께 감사드립니다.
조경디자인성능연구실의 송유진 석사생과 학부연구생이 <2025 보문관광단지 조경+50 대학생 아이디어 공모>에서 최우수상을 수상했습니다.
2025년 8월 1일부터 10일까지 예술의전당 한가람디자인미술관에서 열렸던<Verdant Collectives: 조경가 그룹전> 전시는 ldpl의 조경가 연구 기획 ‘연두빛사람들’ 의 첫 결실이었습니다. 현재 국내에서 활발히 활동 중인 7팀, 총 10인의 조경가가 참여해 조경과의 태도와 작업들을 드러냈습니다.
